description: This file defines a FastAPI backend application for a notes management system. It includes endpoint definitions for health checks and CRUD operations on notes, in-memory storage of notes, and middleware configuration for CORS. The app object created is intended to be run by Uvicorn. The code is organized with clear separation of concerns and uses pydantic models for request and response validation.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a note with id, title, and content.

classes.name: NoteCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating a new note, with optional content.

methods.name: create_app
methods.description: Creates and configures the FastAPI application, including endpoints and middleware.

methods.name: healthz
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning a simple status message.

methods.name: list_notes
methods.description: Returns the list of all notes.

methods.name: create_note
methods.description: Creates a new note and adds it to the in-memory store.

methods.name: get_note
methods.description: Fetches a note by its ID, raising 404 if not found.

methods.name: delete_note
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID, raising 404 if not found.
